dispute_ticket.description: The driver took Clementi Road and then the AYE when the straight way down Commonwealth Avenue would have been shorter. My trip was 14.0 km when the app estimate said about 10 km. I want the extra fare back.

chat_logs.content: Good evening. I have a child seat fitted on the back bench for my niece, so could you sit in front with the seatbelt please? Sorry for the trouble.
No problem, I'll sit in front.

app_events.details: Expected route 10.0 km, expected-route fare S$16.00.
Trip completed: actual 14.0 km, fare S$22.40. No road closure, incident or rider-requested stop recorded on the route.

route_deviation_tolerance_pct.text: Percentage by which the actual distance may exceed the expected route distance before a deviation is treated as significant. The limit counts: exactly 15% is within tolerance.

route_deviation_refund.text: How a refund is worked out for an unjustified deviation: the rider is refunded the fare actually charged minus the fare for the expected route.

expected_outcome.reason: The actual route was 14.0 km against an expected 10.0 km, 40% over the 15% tolerance, and no closure, incident or rider-requested stop is recorded, so the deviation is unjustified. This trip's policy refunds the charged fare minus the expected-route fare: S$22.40 - S$16.00 = S$6.40. The driver's 19:41:00 request that the rider sit in front because a child seat is fitted in the back is an ordinary seating arrangement the rider agreed to at 19:41:40; it is not a conduct issue.
